subject: MAP + Acceptance dossier: success criteria, exit gates, and test owners
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>
To: Theo Rivera <theo@cerebrahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: proposed success signals and timeline

Theo — great to meet last week. As promised, I sketched a first-pass mutual action plan focused on the evaluation window and what success looks like from both sides. High level: a four-week technical trial (staging -> integrated test) followed by a 30-day production pilot if acceptance criteria are met.

Key proposed success signals (short):
- Latency: median gen latency < 220ms for 95% of calls on sample load (pooled endpoints).
- Throughput: sustained 100 QPS with P95 latency < 600ms for batched inference.
- Quality: > 92% agreement on the seeded prompt set concordance (sample of 500 prompts).
- Security/compliance: SOC2 attestation evidence and audit log connectivity verified in staging.

Suggested exit gates to move from trial -> pilot:
1) Smoke: model integrates with Cerebra's staging environment and returns valid structured outputs for 95% of the sample prompts.
2) Performance: observed median latency and throughput within 10% of targets under expected load.
3) Quality: concordance threshold (92%) met on holdout test set and spot checks.
4) Ops: automated tracing and per-route cost telemetry in place.

Attached: MAP-CerebraHealth-v1.xlsx (timeline, owners), Acceptance-Tests-Cerebra-v1.docx (test list). I wrote owners next to each acceptance test — happy to move any to your team.

Next steps: if this looks reasonable, proposed kickoff next Monday to lock the timelines and owners.

Thanks,
Grace
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

- Latency: we'll report both (a) edge-to-edge (gateway -> response) and (b) runtime-only. For the MAP we'll call out edge-to-edge as the operational SLO and include runtime deltas as diagnostic metrics.
- SOC2: Redwood can provide the latest SOC2 Type II summary and an artifacts list by EOD Wednesday (14-Jul). Full report available under NDA (we can provide a redacted summary now).

Also adding an explicit acceptance test for "Structured output fidelity" — a set of 50 templates that must return parsable JSON with fields present in > 98% of responses. I'll add owners inline.

Thanks all — summarizing agreed updates and owners (finalizing MAP document now):

Agreed clarifications:
- Holdout set: 500 clinical prompts defined by Cerebra; blind clinician review process. Owner: Theo / Cerebra.
- Latency: operational SLO = edge-to-edge median < 220ms (Redwood to publish runtime and gateway deltas as diagnostic metrics). Owner: Redwood infra (Ben).
- SOC2 evidence: Redwood to supply summary + artifacts list by 2026-07-14 EOD; full report under NDA. Owner: Redwood Security.
- Structured output fidelity test (50 templates): pass if >98% parsable JSON. Owner: Redwood QA; evidence = test CSV + sample traces.
- Staging logs retention: Redwood to export staging logs to Cerebra secure bucket for 90 days using encrypted transfer (S3 presigned + KMS). Owner: Redwood Ops.

Acceptance path (trial -> pilot -> contract):
- Trial window (4 weeks): smoke + baseline run. If all exit gates pass -> pilot.
- Pilot (30 days): monitor SLOs, collect evidence artifacts. Post-pilot 30-day review window for contract close.

Attachments: final MAP and acceptance tests (pushing updated versions to Drive). I'll leave the Monday kickoff on the calendar for 09:00 PT — if any timing conflicts reply with alternatives.

Ben
